title: kith-tui: ownerUserId empty-string rejection at startup is too strict
description: main.rs rejects startup if session.owner_user_id.is_empty() with a fatal error. This is correct for production kithd. However integration tests that stub the session endpoint and do not include ownerUserId (or include it as empty string) will now fail to initialize the TUI at all. The ownerUserId field has #[serde(default)] so absent JSON → empty String → fatal. Tests that use a mock session must now include a non-empty ownerUserId. This is not currently broken (tests already include it), but future test authors who write a minimal session stub will hit a cryptic error. The error message ('server did not return ownerUserId') is good; the issue is that #[serde(default)] silently swallows missing-field rather than making it required.
